provenance.note: Generated by drivers/survival on the pystatsval harness against a PyPI-installed pystatistics==4.0.0 (the consistency release — standardized API, unchanged mathematics). Correctness fits both pystatistics and R survival on the identical survival::lung rows; discrete-time is validated against R glm(binomial) on the identical reconstructed person-period design (guarded by a person_period_n check). The Cox PH scaling study sweeps a synthetic proportional-hazards DGP on CPU. Host: powerhouse (Apple Silicon, CPU fp64, R 4.5.2 / survival 3.8.3).
provenance.baseline: First survival report. Wave-2 broad-corpus rebuild under the validation architecture, salvaging the archived suite-1 R references.

r.engine: R survival::survfit / survdiff / coxph; glm(binomial) for discrete-time

reference.name: R survival::survfit / survdiff / coxph
reference.what: The R survival package (Therneau): survfit() for Kaplan-Meier, survdiff() for the log-rank test, coxph() for proportional hazards. Discrete-time survival is validated against R glm(family=binomial) on the identical person-period design pystatistics builds internally.

studies.title: Correctness vs R survival — Powerhouse (CPU / fp64), per quantity
Wall-clock vs R on survival::lung — Powerhouse (CPU / fp64)
studies.note: Per-fit median over timed repeats. KM and log-rank are one-pass reductions and match or beat R; Cox PH is already ~22x slower than R at n=227 — the concordance + risk-set hotspots (findings O1/O2), quantified by the scaling study below.

studies.title: Cox PH CPU scaling vs R — Powerhouse (CPU / fp64)
studies.note: Synthetic proportional-hazards DGP. pystatistics wall grows ~4x per doubling of n (O(n^2)); R coxph grows ~2x (O(n log n)). The pystatistics/R ratio roughly doubles each time n doubles (23x -> 812x over n=250 -> 8000), the signature of the O(n^2) concordance (O1) and per-event-time risk-set recomputation (O2). Correctness is unaffected; these are the held CPU optimizations.

record_fields.max_abs: max absolute difference between pystatistics and R over a quantity's elements
record_fields.max_rel: max relative difference between pystatistics and R over a quantity's elements (correctness headline)
record_fields.n_elements: number of scalar elements compared for that quantity (1 for scalars, vector length otherwise)
record_fields.speedup_vs_r: R wall-clock / pystatistics wall-clock on the same fit (>1 means pystatistics is faster)
record_fields.ratio_pystat_over_r: pystatistics wall-clock / R wall-clock at a given n (grows with n when pystatistics is O(n^2) and R is O(n log n))
